epithet: of the Two Rivers and the Jungle
military_unit: s redu and the jungle Holkan companies:

morphology.compounding_rule: Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god]) layered over Mayan quality+feature compounds (Noh-[feature], Chak-[feature], [color]-witz): the capital Tollanur (the reed-place of stepped towers), Dur-Sharru (king's-fort), Noh-Witzbitu (the great pyramid-temple-city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Akkadian populace keep the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the Mayan substrate keeps the shibal- (lineage, < ch'ib'al) house and the aj-/ix- (he-of/she-of) prefixes on day-and-power names; the throne fuses both - a sharru who also carries a Bit- house-name and a witz-dynastic count.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and vine-choked witz: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Witzbitu', 'the lost Pyramid of [ajaw]'
patterns.military_units: the Sharru's redu (war-host) and the jungle Holkan companies: 'the Standard of Urlandu', 'the Jaguar Holkan', 'the Obsidian-helms'
patterns.ships: river-barges and seagoing trade-canoes: 'Pride of the Naru', 'the Jade Canoe', 'Boat of Tullaru'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' and the cacao/balche'-house: 'The Lapis Cup', 'The Cacao Court', 'The Jade and Stele'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs: Tullaru-, Urlandu-, Numunu-), Mayan morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.mayan: Tulax, Orlanab, Numench, aj-/ix- prefixed), never real Mesopotamian or Maya gods. Same shared pantheon, two registers. All three alignments. The witz (pyramid) and the ziggurat are one altar; the Long-Count calendar and the law-stele bind the sharru and the ajaw alike to the powers.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as -lemnu (Akkadian evil) or demonized in the Mayan register, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner (Maya Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking (Maya Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusankaan the Hoard-Serpent.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gayandu: the alluvial maize-field beneath the stepped witz
holy_symbol_motifs.Tullaru: a winged sun-disc above the law-stele and the bloodletting-glyph
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron blade crossed with the obsidian war-club

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (Akkadian god-house) or the Quhnellu (the Mayan k'uh-nah god-house) atop the witz of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru', 'the Witz of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified law-givers and sharru-kin inscribed on the stele, and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben), honored at the ziggurat and the carved stela atop the witz.

sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rialtu (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tullaru (Maya Tulax) - the sun and judgment

religion.the_one: Itarnu (Akk; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Marakshu, Bakidu-lemnu, the war-fire), and names the Lawful powers - and Itarnu - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the bloodletting-rite turned to dread ends.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu, Tullaru the just, Urlandu of the sworn war, Rialtu the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers lemnu (evil) or demonizes the Mayan Marakab/Wakix/Lusankaan, warded; the law-stele and the Long-Count calendar bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the deified sharru-kin and the uchben, the Mayan forebears) and the city-spirits of the bit-ili and the day-lords; the great powers invoked at the witz-pyramid and the temple situationally

titles._tiers_note: Akkadian ladder, ascending, with the Mayan substrate co-titles folded beneath. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (appointed governor) county over the Mayan sajal; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy over the ajaw-nobility; Rubu (prince) principality echoing the k'uhul ajaw (holy lord); Sharru (king) kingdom over a Sharrutu, the Mayan kalomte' (overlord) folded under the crown; Shar-kishshati (king-of-the-totality) empire over the Kishshatu. The jungle cities keep their ajaw and sajal and their ah-k'in (sun-priest) beneath the Akkadian crown; the sangu (city-priest) and scribal shatammu stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Akkadian and Maya registers (allowed); DISPLAY titles are English.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. No approved commonly-known foreign term applies to this fused Akkadian-Maya register, so English display titles are used throughout. The *_native conlang forms (Akkadian, with Mayan co-titles) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (an Akkadian temple-and-stele aristocracy grown together with the Mayan jungle city-states: the sharru and his rubu-kin at the crown, the shaknu-governors over the kahalu-cities, the witz-priesthood and the scribal ekallu beneath; the Mayan ajaw-nobility and sajal-governors fold into the same ladder)
titles.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king; the crown prince; the baah-ch'ok, head-youth, of the witz-dynasty)

vassalage.fealty: Ade (Akkadian loyalty-oath) / Patan-t'an (Mayan oath of service)
